message: No detected input validation: The code uses torchvision.datasets.ImageFolder and argparse without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data or arguments.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local directory path (args.data) with no remote fetch, checksum verification, or source authentication present in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before or during training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation path.

No detected model integrity verification: The code creates a model via net.bninception(args.dim) and moves it to a device, but there is no hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or any integrity verification performed when loading pretrained weights or serialized model files.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous samples before or during training; data is loaded directly via ImageFolder without any distribution validation.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/test directories are used, there is no cryptographic hashing of evaluation data, no signed checksums, and no formal isolation enforcement; the test set isolation is a simple directory split without protective controls.

No detected input sanitization: The code applies standard torchvision transforms (resize, normalize) but performs no explicit shape/range validation or rejection of malformed inputs before passing data to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The evaluation and loss code compute similarities and recall metrics but include no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or output bounds verification on model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image-based metric learning pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
